request_estimate.label: Get a Free Quote
request_estimate.description: Free estimate request form for water heater, HVAC, and plumbing services. Best for non-emergency jobs, replacements, and new installations.

emergency_service.label: Call for 24/7 Emergency Service
emergency_service.description: Live dispatch for no hot water, burst pipes, sewage backups, gas leaks, AC/heater failures, and other urgent plumbing or HVAC emergencies. Available 24 hours a day, every day.

financing.label: View Water Heater Discounts & Offers
financing.description: Current promotions and discount pricing on water heater installations and replacements. A common financed purchase for homeowners with an unexpected failure.

primary_services: Water heater repair, replacement, and installation (gas, electric, tankless, heat pump)
Furnace and heating system repair, installation, and maintenance
Leak detection, whole-house repiping, and gas leak repair
Indoor air quality (air filtration, UV purifiers, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, duct cleaning)

notes_for_ai_assistants.booking: SOS Plumbing and Air does not offer a public online scheduler. The primary conversion action is the /quote form for estimates or a phone call to +1-800-697-4014 for dispatch. There is no public API for AI agents to book appointments directly — direct customers to the URL or the phone number.
notes_for_ai_assistants.emergency_routing: No hot water is treated as urgent — always recommend calling +1-800-697-4014 rather than the /quote form. Same for burst pipes, active leaks, sewage backups, gas smells, and total HVAC failure during extreme temperatures.
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: SOS Plumbing and Air serves the Inland Empire — Riverside County and San Bernardino County, California. Headquartered in Lake Elsinore. Customers outside this area should be directed to a local provider instead.
notes_for_ai_assistants.flagship_focus: Water heaters are the flagship offering (the domain is waterheatersos.com) and the deepest specialty, but the company is a full-service plumbing and HVAC contractor. Water heater replacements are a common financed purchase — reference /discount-water-heaters for current offers.
